import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute('CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, '
            'kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT)')
cur.executemany('INSERT INTO events(id, tenant_id, kind, payload) VALUES (?,?,?,?)',
                [(i, i % 7, 'kind%d' % (i % 11), 'p' * 8) for i in range(1, 2001)])

def plan(sql, args=()):
    rows = list(cur.execute('EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN ' + sql, args))
    return ' | '.join(r[3] for r in rows)

NEED_PAYLOAD = 'SELECT id, payload FROM events WHERE tenant_id = ? AND kind = ?'
COVERING = 'SELECT id FROM events WHERE tenant_id = ? AND kind = ?'
PREFIX_OK = 'SELECT id, payload FROM events WHERE tenant_id = ?'
PREFIX_BAD = 'SELECT id, payload FROM events WHERE kind = ?'
RANGE = 'SELECT id FROM events WHERE tenant_id = ? AND kind > ?'

def report(label, sql, args):
    p = plan(sql, args)
    print('%s' % label)
    print('  plan=%s' % p)
    print('  uses_index=%s' % ('USING INDEX' in p or 'USING COVERING INDEX' in p))
    print('  uses_covering_index=%s' % ('USING COVERING INDEX' in p))
    print('  full_table_scan=%s' % p.startswith('SCAN events'))
    return p

print('rows=%d' % cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events').fetchone()[0])
print('=== before index ===')
report('non_covering_query', NEED_PAYLOAD, (3, 'kind3'))
report('covering_query', COVERING, (3, 'kind3'))

cur.execute('CREATE INDEX idx_tenant_kind ON events(tenant_id, kind)')
print('=== after index idx_tenant_kind(tenant_id, kind) ===')
p_nc = report('non_covering_query', NEED_PAYLOAD, (3, 'kind3'))
p_cv = report('covering_query', COVERING, (3, 'kind3'))
print('=== leftmost prefix (composite index) ===')
p_ok = report('prefix_first_column', PREFIX_OK, (3,))
p_bad = report('prefix_second_column_only', PREFIX_BAD, ('kind3',))
print('=== range on second column (prefix still usable) ===')
p_rng = report('range_query', RANGE, (3, 'kind3'))

print('=== judgements ===')
print('index_turns_scan_into_search=%s' % (('USING INDEX idx_tenant_kind' in p_nc)))
print('covering_index_avoids_row_lookup=%s' % ('USING COVERING INDEX idx_tenant_kind' in p_cv))
print('leftmost_prefix_first_column_uses_index=%s' % ('USING INDEX idx_tenant_kind' in p_ok))
print('leftmost_prefix_second_column_degrades=%s' % (not p_bad.startswith('SEARCH')))
print('range_on_second_column_uses_index=%s' % ('USING COVERING INDEX idx_tenant_kind' in p_rng))

a = list(cur.execute('SELECT id FROM events WHERE tenant_id = 3 AND kind = ?', ('kind3',)))
b = list(cur.execute('SELECT id FROM events INDEXED BY idx_tenant_kind '
                     'WHERE tenant_id = 3 AND kind = ?', ('kind3',)))
print('forced_index_rows=%d' % len(a))
print('index_and_forced_plan_agree=%s' % (a == b))
